feature_sets.description: Same lightgbm configuration and identical train/test rows of the prediction year. Only the input columns change, except for the last row which is the project's real temporal forecast.

ratio_model.description: lightgbm fitted on log(unit_price / lag_unit_price) with the same attributes, then reconstructed as lag * exp(prediction).

cross_series_check.description: Generalisation check on the secondary series (基準地価). Trained on 令和7年 with a genuine measured lag from 令和6年, then scored on 令和6年 itself, split in half. 令和6年 rows have no earlier file to draw a lag from, so every model is fitted on attributes only (the lag baseline is undefined there). The series selects different sites, so these numbers are not comparable with the 公示地価 table.
